sources: https://opencode.ai/docs/go/ (page dated Oct 11, 2026): DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Peak, per 1M tokens: input $0.30, output $1.20, cached read $0.006; Off-Peak: $0.15 / $0.60 / $0.003
https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing: deepseek-flash (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash), Peak: input cache miss $0.30, output $1.20; Off-peak: $0.15 / $0.60
priceBasis.rule: Conservative upper bound: the higher (Peak) rate of both price lists, every input token treated as a cache miss, completion tokens as reported by the Provider (reasoning tokens are part of them). The two lists agree, so the higher of the two is the same figure.
priceBasis.subscription: OpenCode Go is a subscription (Go $10/month) whose usage is metered against these per-token prices. Whether a call consumes plan allowance or new cash is not visible to this tool; the budget gate counts every call at the list price above regardless. Plan allowance consumed and new cash are therefore not separable here: actual new cash is at most the figure recorded and may be zero.

decision.statement: Relayed to the T08 agent by the coordinating agent as Luke's words: "#307 的遗留问题,应当在 T01–T07 开发期间解决了(包括耗时问题和回忆历史消息等),因此 T08 可以正常启动" and "授权 T08 调用 OpenCode Go 跑真实 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 模型". This is a decision to proceed. It is not a record that the #307 online acceptance was completed: #307 was closed with its online acceptance not passed.

entries.note: One real DeepSeek V4.1 Flash request recorded in eval/conversation-time-307/README.md. The Provider reported no monetary cost. Upper bound assigned on 2026-10-11 (T08 #321) at the conservative rate above: 2,131 x $0.30/M + 564 x $1.20/M = $0.0013161, rounded up.
